name: dmnd_throat
description: DMND funnel throat between a TTAN plenum plate and a URAN liner, with a cryo PRTI/PRTO pair and a NEUT/CLNE seed.
why: Save1 'how it works' #2-3: neutrons drop through the DMND throat from the fuel bed into the chamber below; PRTI ch-1 brings cryo feed in on the west side, PRTO ch-1 sends it back out the east side, and a WIFI/PSCN tap ignites the CLNE(NEUT) seed that starts the chain. v2 hardening (blueprint_lint had 3 critical findings): (1) PRTO gets a plain 4-side INSL wrap -- nothing else in the module touches it, so no signal path needed preserving; (2) the WIFI ignition tap is widened by 1 column (away from the PSCN it touches) so a full INSL ring can wrap it while the original PSCN contact -- the actual ignition signal entry -- stays touching WIFI exactly as captured; (3) the conductive_floor_span finding on the full-width TTAN plenum plate is fixed by splitting it into two TTAN halves with a 2px INSL gap at the midpoint (the rule's own suggested fix), well clear of the DMND funnel and URAN liner which sit on rows below it. Note: PRTI is not covered by the heat_source_uninsulated rule (it only checks WIFI/PRTO/HEAC) so it is left unjacketed, matching the rule's own scope. Re-verified: blueprint_lint reports zero critical findings, compile ok.
source: save1, x226-290 y228-239 (TTAN plenum y224-227, METL shoulders x244-253/262-271, DMND core x254-261, URAN row y237-239)
